title: Getting started with infosigasp
text: INFOSIGA-SP São Paulo State Traffic Accident Information Management System, maintained DETRAN-SP. publishes, open data, detailed records every traffic crash state São Paulo 2015 onward. infosigasp package wraps download import records. handles makes raw files awkward read directly. files encoded Latin-1 (ISO-8859-1), UTF-8; fields separated semicolons (;); decimal numbers (coordinates) use comma decimal mark; dates formatted DD/MM/YYYY; dataset split across two files (2015–2021 2022 onward).
code: library(infosigasp)

title: Getting started with infosigasp
text: INFOSIGA-SP organises data three linked tables. sinistros — crash events. One row per recorded event, date, time, location (including latitude/longitude), road attributes breakdown many vehicles victims involved, type severity. pessoas — people (victims). One row per person involved, demographic attributes, injury severity , fatalities, date place death. veiculos — vehicles. One row per vehicle involved, make/model, manufacturing model years, colour type. three share id_sinistro key, can joined together; pessoas veiculos additionally share id_veiculo.
code: infosiga_datasets() #> # A tibble: 3 × 4 #>   dataset   description                                              grain keys  #>   <chr>     <chr>                                                    <chr> <chr> #> 1 sinistros Traffic crash events recorded in the state of Sao Paulo. one … id_s… #> 2 pessoas   People (victims) involved in traffic crashes.            one … id_p… #> 3 veiculos  Vehicles involved in traffic crashes.                    one … id_v…

title: Getting started with infosigasp
text: main entry point read_infosiga(). first call downloads source archive (120 MB) per-user cache; subsequent calls read cache, pay download cost . year argument restricts import specific years, filtering year crash (ano_sinistro).

title: Getting started with infosigasp
text: default read_infosiga() returns processed dataset (clean = TRUE). processing never renames columns, recodes category labels drops rows. fixes types source artefacts. full, ordered list steps lives ?clean_infosiga; main ones . Dates times. Full dates parsed Date times hms (modes), ano_mes_* year-month columns (published "YYYY/MM") become first--month Date values. Whitespace. Text columns lose leading trailing whitespace. source pads fields fixed width (nacionalidade ships "BRASILEIRA          "); untrimmed, values break grouping joins. Missing values. "NAO DISPONIVEL" (“available”) marker becomes NA (trimming runs first, space-padded markers caught). dia_da_semana: Domingo < … < Sábado (Brazilian week starts Sunday); turno: MADRUGADA < MANHA < TARDE < NOITE; gravidade_lesao (victims): LEVE < GRAVE < FATAL; faixa_etaria_demografica / faixa_etaria_legal: age bands order. Crash-type flags. binary tp_sinistro_* columns ("S" / empty) become logical, can sum() filter directly. categorical tp_sinistro_primario stays text. Numeric strings. tempo_sinistro_obito (days crash death) becomes integer, numero_logradouro loses spurious trailing ".0" export appends ("193.0"). Coordinates. latitude/longitude outside São Paulo state bounding box become NA pair. mis-encoded values (0, 0) placeholders, percent records. rows dropped; pass clean = FALSE raw coordinates. dia_da_semana ordered factor, weekday tabulation comes calendar order rather alphabetically. Pass clean = FALSE rather data exactly published, every text column character vector "NAO DISPONIVEL" source’s whitespace padding preserved verbatim. clean_infosiga() applies processing raw import fact.
code: sinistros <- read_infosiga("sinistros") levels(sinistros$dia_da_semana) table(sinistros$dia_da_semana) raw <- read_infosiga("sinistros", clean = FALSE) processed <- clean_infosiga(raw, "sinistros")

title: Getting started with infosigasp
text: clean_infosiga() fixes types source artefacts never touches category labels, anyone reproducing official DETRAN-SP figure gets exactly categories DETRAN-SP publishes. labels , however, genuinely messy. analysis, run opt-second pass tidy_infosiga_labels(). Vehicle colour clearest case. source carries dozens distinct values sixteen real colours, two upstream systems coexist every year, one upper-case one title-cased, two disagree gender agreement. Note toupper() alone merge Branca Branco. remaining changes listed . Place names. source publishes municipio unaccented ("SAO PAULO") regiao_administrativa keeps accents, neither joins Brazilian data published. take official IBGE spelling. profissao Title Cased, merges several hundred values differ another capitalisation, stray "NAO INFORMADA" markers become NA. conservacao mixes name maintaining body ("PREFEITURA") bare route codes ("10.03"); codes move new conservacao_codigo column. Two limits worth naming. profissao keeps unaccented spelling occupations stay ungrouped, authoritative list covers free-text values. conservacao names keep source capitalisation, brand acronyms (SPMAR, TEBE, CART) Title Case corrupt Spmar Tebe.
code: veiculos <- read_infosiga("veiculos") |>   tidy_infosiga_labels("veiculos")  sort(table(veiculos$cor_veiculo), decreasing = TRUE)

title: Getting started with infosigasp
text: infosiga_municipios lookup ships package maps cod_ibge spellings 645 municipalities. Always join cod_ibge, never name. IBGE INFOSIGA-SP spell nine municipalities differently. title: Clean and process an INFOSIGA-SP dataset — clean_infosiga
text: processing standardises missing values, fixes source formatting artefacts assigns meaningful types columns whose published representation inconvenient (ordinal text, binary flags, year-month strings). never renames columns, recodes category labels drops rows. clean_infosiga() applies following steps, order. Every step idempotent, calling function already-processed dataset changes nothing. Whitespace. Trims leading trailing whitespace every text column. source fields space-padded fixed width (example nacionalidade published "BRASILEIRA          "); without trimming, comparisons, grouping joins columns silently fail. Missing values. Replaces literal "NAO DISPONIVEL" ("available") marker NA every text column. Trimming runs first, space-padded markers also caught. Ordered factors. Ordinal columns become ordered factors natural order. dia_da_semana: Domingo < ... < Sabado (Brazilian week starts Sunday). turno: MADRUGADA < MANHA < TARDE < NOITE. gravidade_lesao (pessoas): LEVE < GRAVE < FATAL. faixa_etaria_demografica, faixa_etaria_legal (pessoas): age bands increasing order. Year-month dates. Parses year-month columns (ano_mes_sinistro, ano_mes_obito), published "YYYY/MM" strings, first--month Date values, matching Date class already used full-date columns. Crash-type flags (sinistros). binary tp_sinistro_* columns become logical (TRUE / FALSE). mark whether crash involved given event type published "S" (yes) empty (). categorical tp_sinistro_primario (primary crash type, e.g. "COLISAO") flag stays text. tp_sinistro_colisao_traseira empty every record source therefore becomes uniformly FALSE. unpopulated upstream field, evidence rear-end collisions occurred. crash may also set several flags , flags partition data. Days death (pessoas). tempo_sinistro_obito, number days crash victim's death (published numeric string), becomes integer. Street numbers kilometre markers (sinistros). numero_logradouro carries house number urban streets kilometre marker highways, fractional part meaningful ("0.25" km 250 m, malformed house number). Genuine decimals common ESTRADAS E RODOVIAS rows rare VIAS URBANAS ones. trailing ".0" source export stripped ("193.0" -> "193"); decimal part survives. column stays character two meanings comparable single numeric scale. Coordinates (sinistros). Validates latitude/longitude pair bounding box state Sao Paulo. Points outside box, mis-encoded values (0, 0) "null island" placeholders, coordinates set NA. affects percent records drops rows. Use clean = FALSE need raw coordinates. Nominal text columns (municipio, tipo_via sexo) stay character vectors. Well-typed numeric columns, notably idade (victim's age, pessoas), pass unchanged range-checked. Missing ages NA ages 0 (infants) kept. package enforces bound idade, validate analysis sensitive outliers.

title: Import an INFOSIGA-SP dataset — read_infosiga
text: dataset dataset import. One : "sinistros" Crash events (one row per event). "pessoas" Victims / people involved (one row per person). "veiculos" Vehicles involved (one row per vehicle). clean Logical. TRUE (default), return processed dataset: text trimmed, "NAO DISPONIVEL" marker becomes NA, ordinal columns become ordered factors, crash-type flags become logical, impossible coordinates become NA (see clean_infosiga() full list steps). FALSE, return raw data exactly published, text columns character vectors. year Optional integer vector used filter rows year crash (ano_sinistro). NULL (default), available years returned. example, year = 2020:2023. download_if_missing Logical. TRUE (default), download archive already cached. FALSE archive missing, informative error raised. quiet Logical. FALSE (default), report progress. ... Additional arguments passed infosiga_download() (example overwrite = TRUE force refresh).

text: Source files encoded Latin-1 (ISO-8859-1), use ; field separator, , decimal mark DD/MM/YYYY dates. read_infosiga() handles returns UTF-8 text, Date columns numeric coordinates. dataset distributed across two period files inside archive (2015-2021 2022 onward); read row-bound transparently. default (clean = TRUE) result processed clean_infosiga(): text columns whitespace-trimmed, "NAO DISPONIVEL" ("available") marker becomes NA, ordinal columns (dia_da_semana, turno, gravidade_lesao, age bands) become ordered factors, ano_mes_* year-month strings parsed first--month Dates, binary tp_sinistro_* crash-type flags become logical, tempo_sinistro_obito becomes integer, latitude/longitude values outside bounding box Sao Paulo state become NA. See clean_infosiga() complete, ordered list. Pass clean = FALSE obtain raw data exactly published, every text column kept character vector "NAO DISPONIVEL" source's fixed-width whitespace padding preserved verbatim. small fraction rows source contain data-quality issues (example, unescaped ; inside street name, mis-encoded coordinates). value parsed declared column type set NA recorded readr::problems(). Empty fields read NA modes. raw data (clean = FALSE) crash-type flag columns (tp_sinistro_*) hold "S" flag applies NA otherwise; clean = TRUE converted logical.

title: infosigasp 0.1.0
text: Initial release. Added read_infosiga(), downloads (caching) imports three INFOSIGA-SP datasets (sinistros, pessoas, veiculos) tibbles, handling source encoding, decimal marks date formats. Added clean_infosiga(), applied default, trims text, maps "NAO DISPONIVEL" NA, makes ordinal columns ordered factors, parses ano_mes_* columns first--month Dates, turns tp_sinistro_* crash-type flags logical, casts tempo_sinistro_obito integer, strips spurious ".0" numero_logradouro, voids coordinates outside São Paulo state bounding box. Added clean = FALSE read_infosiga() raw data published. Added tidy_infosiga_labels(), opt-second pass rewrites category labels analysts need published categories verbatim: IBGE spellings municipio regiao_administrativa, merged cor_veiculo spellings, Title Cased profissao, route codes split conservacao new conservacao_codigo column. Added infosiga_municipios dataset, pairing official IBGE name INFOSIGA-SP spelling São Paulo municipality, keyed cod_ibge. Added infosiga_download() pre-fetch source archive, falling back GitHub-release mirror DETRAN-SP endpoint unavailable; mirrors go infosigasp.zip_url option. Added warning read_infosiga() infosiga_download() reuses cached archive older infosigasp.stale_days option (30 days default; set Inf disable), since DETRAN-SP refreshes data monthly file name. Added infosiga_cache_dir(), infosiga_cache_list() infosiga_cache_clear() manage -disk cache. Added infosiga_datasets(), lists available datasets keys, infosiga_dictionary(), downloads official data dictionary. Documented coverage caveats source data ?read_infosiga getting-started vignette, chief among 2015–2018 covers fatal crashes , unrestricted per-year count jumps roughly 20-fold 2019. Added package hex logo drawn major road network São Paulo Metropolitan Region INFOSIGA-SP dark blue (data-raw/logo.R).
